$comment: Entries removed from middleware in a way no dump can express. The generator computes removals by diffing consecutive dumps, which cannot see something that was deleted from every version directory retroactively — see src/generated/v25_10_0/api-types.ts. Each entry listed under a version is omitted from the surface that version inherits, so regeneration stays idempotent and the omission cannot drift out of sync with what v25.10 declares. Two forms: a namespace prefix ending in '.' (omitted from every directory kind as a `prefix${string}` template literal), or one exact entry written 'call|job|event:name' (omitted from that kind as a quoted literal). The kind has to be stated because the dump that would say which it was is the thing that no longer describes it. The version key moved from v26.0.0 to v27.0.0 when middleware renumbered its versions (d3b89cea4d, 26.0.0 -> 27.0.0 and 27.0.0 -> 28.0.0): the release that dropped these is the same one, under its new name, so the removal did not move a version later.
